pathway_links.basis: PathwayMech context: ectoine biosynthesis in Halomonas elongata (NCBITaxon:2746). The shared route synthesizes ectoine through EctB, EctA and EctC. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.

PathwayMech context: trehalose biosynthesis I in Escherichia coli (NCBITaxon:562). The linked OtsA/OtsB route illustrates trehalose synthesis only; it does not cover the transport component of this node. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.

PathwayMech context: L-proline biosynthesis I (from L-glutamate) in Escherichia coli (NCBITaxon:562). The linked route synthesizes L-proline from L-glutamate through the ProB/ProA/ProC enzyme sequence. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.

PathwayMech context: Acetogenesis in Acetobacterium woodii (NCBITaxon:33952). The shared reductive acetyl-CoA route combines methyl and carbonyl branches for acetogenesis; the bacterial exemplar does not establish archaeal variants. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.

PathwayMech context: Acetogenesis in Acetobacterium woodii (NCBITaxon:33952). The shared reductive acetyl-CoA route combines methyl and carbonyl branches for acetogenesis; the bacterial exemplar does not establish archaeal variants. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.

PathwayMech context: Acetogenesis in Acetobacterium woodii (NCBITaxon:33952). The shared reductive acetyl-CoA route combines methyl and carbonyl branches for acetogenesis; the bacterial exemplar does not establish archaeal variants. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.

PathwayMech context: acetate and ATP formation from acetyl-CoA I in Thermotoga maritima (NCBITaxon:2336). The linked route explicitly contains phosphate acetyltransferase and acetate kinase and produces ATP through acetyl phosphate. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.

PathwayMech context: L-arginine degradation V (arginine deiminase pathway) in Halobacterium salinarum (NCBITaxon:2242). The linked arginine deiminase route contains the ATP-forming carbamate kinase step; it does not assert that the full pathway is equivalent to this enzyme node. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.

PathwayMech context: Acetogenesis in Acetobacterium woodii (NCBITaxon:33952). The shared reductive acetyl-CoA route combines methyl and carbonyl branches for acetogenesis; the bacterial exemplar does not establish archaeal variants. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.

PathwayMech context: mevalonate pathway in Saccharomyces cerevisiae S288C (NCBITaxon:559292). The shared mevalonate route supplies isoprenoid precursors; the yeast pathway is context for the route, not evidence for bacterial pigmentation. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.

PathwayMech context: chorismate biosynthesis I in Escherichia coli (NCBITaxon:562). The linked shikimate route terminates at chorismate; it provides precursor context, not a complete phenazine or pigment pathway. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.

PathwayMech context: Acetogenesis in Acetobacterium woodii (NCBITaxon:33952). The shared reductive acetyl-CoA route combines methyl and carbonyl branches for acetogenesis; the bacterial exemplar does not establish archaeal variants. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.

PathwayMech context: superoxide radicals degradation in Saccharomyces cerevisiae S288C (NCBITaxon:559292). The linked model explicitly includes CTT1 (SGD:S000003320) catalase activity consuming hydrogen peroxide and producing water and dioxygen, downstream of superoxide dismutation. This link concerns that peroxide-removal component; it does not equate catalase with superoxide dismutase or extend the bacterial PerR/OxyR regulatory branches to yeast.

PathwayMech context: heme b biosynthesis I (aerobic) in Saccharomyces cerevisiae S288C (NCBITaxon:559292). This is one aerobic heme b synthesis route supplying catalase cofactor context; alternative bacterial heme routes and PerR/OxyR regulation are outside the linked record. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.

PathwayMech context: glycolysis I (from glucose 6-phosphate) in Saccharomyces cerevisiae S288C (NCBITaxon:559292). This record covers only the glycolysis part of the composite node, beginning at glucose 6-phosphate. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.

PathwayMech context: pentose phosphate pathway (oxidative branch) I in Escherichia coli (NCBITaxon:562). This record covers the oxidative pentose phosphate branch of the composite node. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.

PathwayMech context: pentose phosphate pathway (non-oxidative branch) I in Escherichia coli (NCBITaxon:562). This record covers the non-oxidative pentose phosphate branch of the composite node. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.

PathwayMech context: TCA cycle - detailed in Saccharomyces cerevisiae (NCBITaxon:4932). The shared route is the oxidative tricarboxylic acid cycle; the linked yeast model is an example, not a universal microbial enzyme assignment. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.

PathwayMech context: glyoxylate cycle in Mycobacterium tuberculosis (NCBITaxon:1773). The shared route bypasses the decarboxylating TCA steps through isocitrate lyase and malate synthase. No exact equivalence or transfer of organism scope is asserted.
